source.description: Derived from work order master project names
source.valueSql:
SELECT DISTINCT value FROM (
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM work_orders
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM inspections
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM quality_records
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM supervision_projects
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
         ) t

source.description: Derived from active quality records and inspection requests
source.valueSql:
SELECT DISTINCT value FROM (
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM quality_records
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM qms_inspection_requests
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM work_order_requirements
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM vehicle_commissioning_issues
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM after_sales
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT part_name AS value
           FROM project_boms
           WHERE part_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(part_name) <> ''
         ) t

source.description: Derived from work order master project names
source.valueSql:
SELECT DISTINCT value FROM (
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM work_orders
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM inspections
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM quality_records
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT projectName AS value
           FROM supervision_projects
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND projectName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(projectName) <> ''
         ) t

source.description: Derived from active quality records and inspection requests
source.valueSql:

           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM quality_records
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM qms_inspection_requests
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM work_order_requirements
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM vehicle_commissioning_issues
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT partName AS value
           FROM after_sales
           WHERE isDeleted = 0 AND partName IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(partName) <> ''
           UNION
           SELECT part_name AS value
           FROM project_boms
           WHERE part_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(part_name) <> ''
         ) t
